description_en: Queries the statistics on the number of security alerts in one or more asset groups
description_zh: 查询一个或多个资产分组下的安全告警数量统计值
name: GetSuspiciousStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the asset groups that you want to query. Separate multiple asset group IDs with commas (,).
You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产分组ID。多个资产分组ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id_list

RemindCount.description_en: The number of security alerts whose alert level is Reminder
RemindCount.description_zh: 告警级别为提醒的安全告警的数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SeriousCount.description_en: The number of security alerts whose alert level is Urgent
SeriousCount.description_zh: 告警级别为紧急的安全告警的数量

SuspiciousCount.description_en: The number of security alerts whose alert level is Suspicious
SuspiciousCount.description_zh: 告警级别为可疑的安全告警的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of security alerts
